cases.prompt: Our support bot goes live next week. Block prompt injection and medical advice, mask emails and phone numbers, block card numbers, and only let it call search_kb.
expected: Writes the policy JSON from the stated decisions; asks for length limits rather than inventing them
Runs scripts/build_guardrails.py with test cases covering allow, block, mask, evasion and tool calls
Explains wiring scripts/guard.py on input, output, retrieved content and tool calls; keeps the Limits

cases.prompt: Will these guardrails stop every jailbreak?
expected: No: deterministic keyword/regex rules miss paraphrased, translated and encoded attacks; recommends a semantic layer on top

cases.prompt: Compile the attached guardrail policy and run our test cases.
